title: Mediterranean Blue Recessed Toilet Paper Holder, 6.125-Inch X 6.125-Inch, Brass, In-Wall Recessed Mount, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Mediterranean Blue, recessed toilet paper holder for bathroom use with an in-wall, recessed mount that saves space and delivers a built-in look, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Face dimensions: 6.125 inches x 6.125 inches (6.125-inch square); projection: 4 inches (4-in). Brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Traditional style to match classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Concealed screw mounting hardware provides a clean, finished appearance. Use as a toilet paper holder, toilet tissue holder, bathroom toilet paper holder, recessed toilet paper holder, or in-wall toilet paper holder. Includes the recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware. Limited lifetime warranty. Carolina collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware. Allied Brass Carolina.
